entities.summary: Domenico Luca "Mimmo" Schiattarella is an Italian racing driver. He participated in seven Formula One Grands Prix for Simtek, debuting on October 16, 1994, and finishing when the team folded the next year. He scored no championship points, with a best finish of ninth in the 1995 Argentine Grand Prix.
